name: steering-pragmatic
description: Rules for what an agent PRODUCES: code economy (prefer deletion, stdlib, and minimal solutions over new abstractions), comment discipline, written-artifact register, and no justification for a choice inside the artifact that ships. Always-on steering as main-session instructions, plus a SubagentStart hook that injects the same discipline into every subagent in MUST register, since a subagent writes files too. Conversational register is not here: on Claude it is the `Pragmatic` output style, which reaches the main session's system prompt. Requires python3 on PATH. Opt-in.
